messages:
marie_cs: Quick flag — hosted spend anomaly for Pelotonia Inc this week. Dashboard shows week spend $21,300 vs committed $7,500. Auto anomaly score 0.89. Posting details.

opsbot: [AUTOMATED] Anomaly detected for customer pelotonia-inc (acct ACC-137)
- metric: hosted_api_spend
- prior_week: $7,500
- current_week: $21,300
- delta: +184%
- anomaly_score: 0.89
- error_rate: 0.4% (baseline 0.35%)
- p50 latency: 120ms (baseline 115ms)

sam_csm: Yikes. Do we know if this is organic traffic or test keys?

lia_support: Pulling request logs now — filtering by account_id ACC-137 and last 7 days.

lia_support: Found a burst between 2026-03-15 02:10–04:05 UTC. client_key: stg-loadtest-09 used ~320k requests, most short sequences. Suspect internal load test.

lia_support: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:03Z] acct=ACC-137 key=stg-loadtest-09 model=vicuna-13b req_tokens=120 resp_tokens=16
[2026-03-15T02:12:03Z] acct=ACC-137 key=stg-loadtest-09 model=vicuna-13b req_tokens=130 resp_tokens=18
... (repeated ~320k times)
```

ryan_eng: Infra note — we saw elevated request concurrency but no infra errors. Runtime auto-fallback triggered twice to a lower-memory variant; KV cache hit rate dropped during the burst which increased per-token compute.

nora_fin: If this is indeed a load test on staging using non-prod keys, billing policy is still per-usage. We can propose a goodwill credit for a one-time accidental test, but need AE sign-off.

marie_cs: I'll loop in AE and the customer. @sam_csm can you set up a sync with Pelotonia POC today? Also propose a one-time credit up to $8k while we confirm.

sam_csm: Scheduling now — 30-min sync at 16:00 PT. Adding agenda: confirm source, discuss key hygiene, discuss commit uplift or caps.

alex_pelotonia: Thanks — confirmed internal QA ran an uncoordinated stress test using a staging key. Really sorry. Can we get usage breakdown and propose a credit? We can also disable the key ASAP.

marie_cs: Sharing breakdown and next steps in the sync. Action items:
- lia_support: confirm exact request timestamps and origin (ETA 2h)
- sam_csm: run the customer sync and capture remediation plan (ETA 6h)
- nora_fin: prepare credit options and billing impact (ETA EOD)
- ryan_eng: add temporary per-key cap option to prevent recurrence (ETA 48h)
- marie_cs: draft customer note and approval for credit up to $8k (ETA 4h)

lia_support: Confirmed origin IPs belong to Pelotonia's test subnet. Marking as accidental. Will flag the staging key as compromised and recommend rotation.

nora_fin: Prelim estimate: if we grant $8k credit, net billed this month would be ~$13,300. Need finance ok, but option looks reasonable to retain them.

marie_cs: Agreed. Sam, please capture acceptance from Alex on remediation steps during the sync.

sam_csm: Done — customer acknowledged, will rotate keys and set internal guardrails. They requested a one-time credit request in writing; I'll attach to AE ticket.

marie_cs: Filed AE ticket #AE-4821 for credit request and resolution. Closing the loop here once finance approves. :white_check_mark:

opsbot: [SYSTEM] Ticket AE-4821 created by marie_cs for account ACC-137.

marie_cs: Closing thread after finance confirms. Thanks team. :pray:
